plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from Webster University's official 'Undergraduate Course Sequence and Degree Plans | College of Humanities and Social Sciences' page (Psychology), Four-Year Program Sequence, Effective Catalog 2025-2026. Semester totals match the page's stated totals (15 x 8 = 120). The source lists many recommended (not required) courses marked with asterisks; recommended courses are recorded as choice slots with the recommendation documented in the choice_note (e.g., PSYC 3825, PSYC 4700, PSYC 4425, PSYC 4825, PSYC 4750). Year 3 Fall 'Lifespan Developmental Perspectives course': PSYC 2200, 2250, 2300 or 2950. Year 4 Spring: the source lists 'PSYC xxxx | PSYC Electives or other electives | Varies; estimated 12' — recorded at the source's own estimate of 12 credits, documented here. Prerequisites are not listed in the sequence; prereq arrays are empty (chains live in the catalog course descriptions).
